sessionEnd.comment: Prune orphaned Copilot hook configs left by uninstalled/upgraded tools. Runs at sessionEnd, never sessionStart, to keep startup latency at zero. Fails open.
Retention sweep: extension logs older than 7d, session-state older than 60d. Leaves session-store.db alone. Fails open.

De-duplicate MCP OAuth cache entries. Was a sessionStart hook until 2026-08-27, when sessionStart was emptied for load time; moved here so the anti-thrash protection keeps running at zero startup cost.
